output.borrower_letter:
Dear Tina,

Thank you for applying with us. Here is the loan option we suggest. A loan officer will make the final decision, so this is not an approval yet.

Our suggestion: USDA 502 Guaranteed 30-year fixed loan
- Monthly payment: $689.60 (loan only)
- APR: 6.25%
- Number of months: 360
- Total cost over the loan: $248,257.18

Taxes, home insurance (about $150 a month) and USDA fees are extra. Your final papers will show the full amounts.

Why this option helps you:
- It has the lowest payment and the lowest total cost of your choices.
- It is made for buyers in rural areas like Steuben County.
- The rate stays the same for all 30 years, with no surprise jumps.
- Your $8,000 in savings can go toward closing costs and a safety cushion.

Good news: we did not count your medical bill against you. You have no late payments.

Next steps: send recent pay stubs and W-2s, show where your $8,000 came from, and get a home appraisal. If USDA takes too long, an FHA loan is a backup.

Warm regards,
Cabaka Credit
